The curated camp subset now includes the tent and canvas, campfire pit and
tripod, workbench, storage, bedroll, water bucket, fuel and hand tools used by
the portable road laboratory.

This project currently includes selected GLB models and their shared color-map
texture. The original `License.txt` is preserved beside them.
